name: UK strikes & disruption
value: No national strike; consultants' action paused
summary: BMA paused the 25–26 Nov consultants' strike for talks; Tube drivers' strikes from 26 Nov are London-only
state: The BMA said on 11 Nov that the consultants' strike in England planned for 25 and 26 Nov is paused while formal negotiations take place (BMA; ITV News). Some Tube drivers plan 24-hour strikes from noon on 26 Nov, with further dates in December, January and February, and likely network-wide disruption in London (UCL). These are London-only, and searches on 21 Nov found no national-scale strike or nationwide disruption due, so the signal stays Normal.
for_you: London commuters face disruption on Tube strike days from 26 Nov; check TfL before travelling. NHS services in England are not expected to be affected by consultant action while talks continue.
rubric_hit: Normal: no national-scale strike this week; consultants' strike paused, Tube strikes London-only

why: Strikes and infrastructure failures in rail, health, ports and power disrupt daily life and the economy.
drivers: Pay disputes, infrastructure failures, cyber incidents, weather.

rubric.alert: Multiple simultaneous national strikes, or nationwide infrastructure failure.

rubric.normal: No national-scale strikes or disruption this week.
